previousRun.description: UTC time of the previous watch run this score was compared to; null on a first read (the Solana targets had no previous run on 10/10). Not enforced: a documentation entry.

target_network.description: the network this target was placed on, or 'unplaced (...)' with the reason: never a default

code_on_target_network.description: true when code exists at the address on the network the target was placed on (read at target_read_block); false when the main network of the oracle has none and no other network was found; null when not applicable (HyperCore) or the read failed

account_on_target_network.description: Solana: true when an account exists at the address on mainnet-beta, false when not, null when the read failed

target_network_read.description: what was read to place the target on that network, and where (code at a block on a host, a genesis, a HyperCore role)

target_read_block.description: the block (Solana: slot) of the network the target was placed on at which its code or account was read; null for a HyperCore object, which has no block

requiredFromParent.description: when the record carries target_network, every target carries its own network

self_scanned_to.description: the last block up to which the oracle's own role events were scanned successfully (the next scan starts there, so a window lost to an eth_getLogs failure is read the next time); the block of the run when the scan worked. Not enforced: a documentation entry.

self.description: the oracle's own authority since the previous run: role events, code hash, hasRole of the known holders, and the error when a read failed. Not enforced: a documentation entry.

oracle_network.description: the network the ORACLE contract lives on (a test network: Sepolia, devnet, Moderato...), written only once its chain id or genesis was read and is the expected one; otherwise 'unplaced (read impossible)'

oracle_chain_id.description: eth_chainId READ on the oracle RPC (null for Solana, or when the read failed: see oracle_chain_read_error)

oracle_genesis.description: Solana only: the genesis hash read on the oracle RPC

target_network.description: the network the scored TARGETS live on (mainnet), written only once its chain id or genesis was read and is the expected one; otherwise 'unplaced (read impossible)'

target_chain_id.description: eth_chainId READ on the target network's RPC (null for Solana: see target_genesis)

target_block.description: head (EVM block number, Solana slot) of the TARGET network when the Watch read the oracle. NOT the block the scorer read.

target_read_error.description: why the target network could not be read; the fields stay null, never zero

target_fallback_errors.description: why a second network (Ethereum for the Robinhood rollup contracts, Arbitrum One for the Hyperliquid bridge) could not be read

networks_version.description: 1 in every record written with the network fields (the Watch writes it even when a network could not be read, with the cause). A record without it was written before and stays valid.

requiredWhen.description: a record that carries networks_version names the network of the oracle and of its targets
